scripts.test: pnpm workspace:check && node --test tests/bootstrap.test.mjs && pnpm --recursive run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm workspace:check && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm workspace:check && pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
